raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure presents a bar graph illustrating the daily number of new COVID-19 cases and related news reports over time. The graph's horizontal axis represents dates from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with each bar corresponding to a specific day. The vertical axis on the left side denotes the number of people, ranging from 0 to 1,800,000, with increments of 200,000. A secondary vertical axis on the right side indicates the number of news reports, ranging from 0 to 6,000, with increments of 1,000. The graph features two data series: a teal series representing the daily global confirmed cases, depicted as bars, and a blue series representing the number of COVID-19-related news reports, depicted as a line. The teal bars vary significantly in height, with the tallest bar reaching approximately 1,700,000 and the shortest bar at around 400,000. The blue line fluctuates, peaking at around 3,500 and troughing at approximately 500. The graph does not display any specific grouping, stacking, or sorting of the bars, and there are no emphasized bars through shading, bolding, or outlining.
